title: TodayEventCancelledPayload
description: today.event.cancelled v1 (OpenVibe.Today server/events/store.js, written to its outbox in the same transaction as the change and published once per evt_ id). Its owner cancelled it: calendars that subscribe drop it (STATUS:CANCELLED), and OpenVibe.Network clears the followers' notices. Envelope: source today, subject and actor { type: user, id: <owner usr_> }, visibility internal, priority important. OpenVibe.Network tells a streamer's followers about a scheduled public or followers-only stream (STREAM_SCHEDULED) and clears those notices on cancel (server/notifications/events-consumer.js).

event_id.description: Today's id for the calendar entry (not the envelope's evt_ id).

channel.description: The owner's Live username for a stream; null for an event.

tz.description: The IANA zone it was scheduled in.

url.description: Where it happens (a stream: its Live channel page).

seq.description: The calendar SEQUENCE: up by one with every change.
